article.title: LearnPossible – The Hexcore Labs PH University Challenge
article.article_html:
LearnPossible – The Hexcore Labs PH University Challenge

Theme: Your Mission Awaits : University of the Philippines

This one-of-a-kind challenge will test the creativity, collaboration, and technical mastery of university students nationwide. The competition features two high-stakes tournaments:

The Gamified Capture the Flag (CTF) Tournament – A thrilling gauntlet of realistic cybersecurity challenges where every second counts.

The AI Hackathon – A showcase of innovation where teams will design and deploy AI-driven workflow automation solutions.

To prepare participants, we are also hosting Pre-Tournament Workshops introducing the Hexcore Labs platform, covering both cybersecurity and AI tracks. These workshops will run September 16–18, 2025, virtually via Zoom, ensuring your students are well-equipped for the main event.

Event Details:

Date: October 6, 2025

Time: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Venue: Asian Institute of Management, Makati City

We believe your bright and competitive students will rise to this challenge, representing your institution with excellence. This is more than a competition—it is an opportunity for them to gain hands-on experience, sharpen critical skills, and showcase their capabilities on a national stage.

For your reference, we have attached detailed information about the competition tracks, workshop schedule, and event guidelines.

We sincerely hope that  your university will join us in this mission. The digital battlefield is set—the clock is ticking—and we look forward to seeing your champions take the stage.

Should you require further information, please feel free to contact us at team.ph@hexcore-labs.com or reply to this email.

Thank you very much, and we look forward to your participation.

Respectfully yours,

The Hexcore Labs PH Team
